idea-plugin.name: Rider Classic-ish Dark UI
idea-plugin.description: Applies a compact Rider Dark UI profile for Rider 2026.3 EAP without installing the full Classic UI plugin. It suppresses New UI / Islands icon remapping and applies selected classic-ish appearance settings once, while leaving later manual settings changes alone. JetBrains' Extended Tool Windows UI plugin is recommended for the closest classic-style layout.
